description: DevDrive v3 UI Expansion — 10-iteration sprint adding card/graph views, Source Volumes admin, drive relocation, volume settings, OffloadRule management, capacity dashboard, and admin preferences. Builds on the v3 three-tier model (SourceVolume/VolumeBackend/OffloadRule) completed in fmt-lfg-ddrv3-20260524.

harnessMandate.attributionPolicy: Never include Co-Authored-By, Generated with Claude Code, or any AI attribution in commits or PRs

completedWork: CP-109: SourceVolume, OffloadRule, VolumeBackend, FleetRegistry v3 API
CP-112/113/115: DevDriveView three-tier CloudMounter-inspired list with VolumeBackendCard + OffloadRuleRow
CP-114: MenuBarView source groups + filter + drift alerts

agents.title: View switcher toolbar + DevDriveViewMode enum + UserDefaults persistence
acceptanceCriteria: DevDriveViewMode enum: .list, .card, .graph
DevDriveView has @AppStorage('devDriveViewMode') binding
Toolbar has a context menu (or segmented control) to switch modes — Picker with .segmented style preferred
Switching to .list shows existing SourceVolumeSection list (current behaviour)
Switching to .card shows a placeholder CardGridPlaceholderView ('Card view — coming in v3.2')
Switching to .graph shows a placeholder GraphPlaceholderView ('Graph view — coming in v3.3')
Mode persists across app restarts via @AppStorage
swift build passes

agents.title: VolumeCardGridView with LazyVGrid + VolumeCard components
acceptanceCriteria: VolumeCardGridView: LazyVGrid with adaptive columns (min 200pt), one VolumeCard per VolumeBackend
VolumeCard shows: VolumeStatusDot (reuse existing), volume id (title), purpose (subtitle), host badge (colored capsule — green for mounted external, gray for internal), offload rule count badge
VolumeCard has a capacity ring (circular ProgressView or arc shape) showing used/total fraction; unmounted shows ring grayed
VolumeCard tap opens a detail sheet (VolumeDetailSheet) — just a placeholder sheet for now showing id and all properties in a Form
VolumeCardGridView accepts registry: FleetRegistry and sections: [SectionModel] — reuse DevDriveView.SectionModel by extracting it to a shared type or passing backends directly
DevDriveView wires VolumeCardGridView when viewMode == .card (replace the CardGridPlaceholderView)
swift build passes

squadrons.name: Wave 2 — Graph View + Source Volumes Admin

agents.title: VolumeGraphView — static hierarchical node graph (SourceVolume → VolumeBackend → OffloadRule)
acceptanceCriteria: VolumeGraphView renders a static tree layout: SourceVolume nodes at top, VolumeBackend nodes in middle row, OffloadRule nodes at bottom
Each node is a rounded rectangle with appropriate icon + label; color-coded by type (blue=source, green/orange/red=backend by status, gray=rule)
Lines/edges drawn between parent and child nodes using Path or Canvas
Nodes are tappable — show a popover/tooltip with details (id, mount, status)
ScrollView wraps the graph for large fleets
DevDriveView wires VolumeGraphView when viewMode == .graph
swift build passes

agents.title: SourceVolumesAdminView — all mounted APFS/HFS+ volumes via diskutil + register to fleet
acceptanceCriteria: DiskScanner (LFGKit) runs 'diskutil list -plist' async and returns [MountedVolume] (id, name, mount, filesystem, totalBytes, freeBytes, isDevDriveManaged)
SourceVolumesAdminView is a new tab/subpage accessible from DevDriveView toolbar — 'Volumes' button or tab
Shows a List of all mounted volumes grouped: DevDrive-Managed vs Discovered
Each row shows: volume name, mount path, filesystem, capacity bar, a 'Managed' badge for fleet-registered volumes
Unmanaged volumes have a '+  Register' button — tapping opens an AddSourceVolumeSheet (name + role fields, writes to fleet.json external_hosts[])
DevDrive-managed SourceVolumes show their VolumeBackend count as a badge
swift build passes

agents.title: DriveRelocationSheet — move VolumeBackend sparseimage from current host to a new host
acceptanceCriteria: DriveRelocationSheet is a sheet presented from VolumeBackendCard context menu ('Move to...')
Step 1: pick destination SourceVolume from a picker (shows free GB per option)
Step 2: preflight — checks destination has enough free space; shows warning if tight
Step 3: execute — uses Process to run 'cp' (or rsync) to copy the sparseimage, shows progress via RelocationCoordinator
Step 4: on success — updates fleet.json host field and the 'image' path, reloads registry
Step 5: on failure — shows error with rollback option (delete partial copy)
RelocationCoordinator is an actor with async func relocate(backend:toHost:registry:) -> RelocationResult
swift build passes

agents.title: VolumeSettingsSheet — edit VolumeBackend properties and persist to fleet.json
acceptanceCriteria: VolumeSettingsSheet is a sheet presented from VolumeBackendCard ('Settings' button or swipe action)
Form with editable fields: purpose (TextField), tier (Picker: cold/hot/warm/always_internal/archival), reconnect_policy (Picker: auto/manual/none)

FleetEditor (LFGKit) has func update(backendId: String, purpose: String?, tier: String?, reconnectPolicy: String?) throws — reads fleet.json, patches drives[], writes back atomically via temp file + rename
Save button writes changes via FleetEditor and dismisses; Cancel discards
Source volume keep_awake toggle shown for SourceVolume-linked backends
swift build passes

agents.title: OffloadRuleManagerSheet — add/remove symlink rules and create symlinks on demand
acceptanceCriteria: OffloadRuleManagerSheet presented from VolumeBackendCard ('Manage Rules' button)
Lists all existing OffloadRules for the backend with health dots
Remove rule: swipe-to-delete with confirmation alert; updates fleet.json via FleetEditor
Add rule: '+ Add Rule' button opens inline form — source path picker (starts at ~/) + target path field with autocomplete from backend mount point subdirs
One-click 'Create Symlink' for unhealthy rules (calls FileManager.createSymbolicLink)
Validation: warns if source already exists as a real dir (not a symlink)
swift build passes

agents.title: CapacityDashboardView — stacked usage bars + rebalance suggestions
acceptanceCriteria: CapacityDashboardView accessible from DevDriveView toolbar ('Capacity' button or tab)
Shows a horizontal stacked bar chart for each VolumeBackend (used vs free vs unallocated in sparseimage)
Total summary row: sum of all managed sparseimage usage vs host free space
Rebalance suggestions: if any host is >80% full and another has >20GB free, show a suggestion row with a 'Move →' button (wires to DriveRelocationSheet)
Auto-resize suggestion: if sparseimage usage >90%, show 'Resize +5GB' button (runs hdiutil resize via Process)
swift build passes

squadrons.name: Wave 5 — Admin Preferences + Polish + TDD + Docs

swarms.name: v3.9 + v3.10 — Admin Prefs + Polish + TDD + Docs

agents.title: Admin preferences pane — DevDrive settings tab in Settings scene
acceptanceCriteria: DevDriveSettingsView added as a tab in the existing SettingsView

Sections: Auto-Mount (toggle per SourceVolume keep_awake, global threshold slider 75-95%), Notifications (toggle: mount events, drift alerts, capacity warnings), Display (default view mode picker: list/card/graph)
All settings persisted via @AppStorage
swift build passes

agents.title: Polish + TDD for new LFGKit types + CLAUDE.md + README update
acceptanceCriteria: DiskScannerTests: mock plist output, verify MountedVolume parsing, isDevDriveManaged flag
FleetEditorTests: round-trip update (purpose, tier, reconnect_policy), atomic write (temp file + rename), handles missing id gracefully
RelocationCoordinatorTests: mock Process/FileManager, verify success path updates fleet.json, rollback on failure
swift test passes with total tests > 126 and 0 failures
